verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Ornn's E colliding with terrain near his Q slow; you win if you bait both cooldowns and all-in with Q's stun.

brief.thesis: Ornn's E (Searing Charge) is only a real all-in tool when he can collide with terrain for the knockup shockwave — without a wall nearby it's just a linear dash that whiffs easily. Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) stun plus double-W (Frenzied Maul) sustain lets him win any trade Ornn starts without that terrain setup, which is why Volibear sits at 52.2% over 136 games here with a clear solo-kill edge.

theirWindow.when: Ornn near terrain with E up
theirWindow.what: Back off and don't contest in that pocket — his E colliding with a wall creates a knockup shockwave that can chain into his Q slow for a big burst window.

yourWindow.when: Ornn's E and Q both down
yourWindow.what: Walk up and all-in: land Q for the stun, then recast W on the same target twice for the bonus damage and heal. Ornn has no stun or gap-close to escape it.

powerCurve.note: Q stun plus double-W kills fast

start.why: Sustains you through Ornn's long-range Q poke while you wait out cooldowns to engage; the most played start at 47.4% WR over 133 games.

boots.why: Tenacity cuts the duration of Ornn's Q slow and softens any knockup follow-up chain; 53.8% WR, the top boots pick here.

core.why: Highest-winrate core path (71.4% over 14 games) — builds your attack-speed snowball from Frenzied Maul marks.
Cooldown refund on Q and ultimate accelerates your stun-into-all-in loop.
Boosts your W double-cast heal, which is your main sustain edge over Ornn in extended trades.

situational.when: ornn's team stacks burst and you need to survive extended all-ins
you want extra poke damage and sustain to out-lane him
the game goes long and teamfights decide it
you need wave clear and kiting speed against his forged tankiness

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed stacks with your passive and W marks, letting you out-damage Ornn the longer a melee trade goes — which is exactly where you want these fights to live.

summoners.why: Most-played combo here (50.8% WR, 69% pick) and it matches the aggressive, solo-kill-favored shape of this matchup — Ignite closes out the all-ins your Q/W combo sets up.

playing.title: Bait his Q before trading
playing.detail: Stay outside the 800-range threat of Volcanic Rupture until it's on cooldown (9-7s depending on rank), then step in — walking into the slow is what sets up his E follow-up.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed E immediately
playing.detail: Searing Charge (450 range, 14-12s cd) only knocks up if he hits terrain. If he misses without a wall nearby, close with Q for the stun and all-in while his mobility is down.

playing.title: Always land the second W
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul marks on the first cast; recasting on the same target deals bonus damage and heals you. Never trade with just one W — Ornn has no comparable sustain to answer it.

playing.title: Poke with E outside his range
playing.detail: Sky Splitter reaches 1200 range with a slow and a shield if you're in the blast — chip him from outside his Q/E threat range while you wait for his cooldowns.

playing.title: Respect Brittle stacking
playing.detail: Bellows Breath's final gout applies Brittle. If you're tagged, back off his Q pillar and E charge lanes — a follow-up knockup on Brittle deals extra damage.

playing.title: Save R for picks, not neutral trades
playing.detail: Stormbringer is on a long cooldown (160s at rank 1) — hold it to punish overextensions and secure the isolated kills that drive your solo-kill advantage, not to start even trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning — cooldown windows, trade patterns, and the terrain dependency on Ornn's E — is my own read on the kit, not sourced from the data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo. Use [E] to contest lane while using [Q] to fight him in melee combat whenever he is in range.
